text:
規定打席は通常 3.1×試合数（162試合で502打席）ですが、データに打席数（PA）列がないため、打数+四球+死球+犠飛+犠打から打席数を算出して502以上を条件にします。

```sql
SELECT
  playerID,
  SUM(H) * 1.0 / SUM(AB) AS batting_avg
FROM Batting
WHERE yearID = 2021
GROUP BY playerID
HAVING SUM(AB + COALESCE(BB,0) + COALESCE(HBP,0) + COALESCE(SF,0) + COALESCE(SH,0)) >= 502
ORDER BY batting_avg DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
